charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Swings her chain and anchor, dealing AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents and summoning an Anchor that follows the current on-field character's movements.
description.2: While the Anchor is present, it will assist in combat in different ways depending on whether Danica is on the field.
description.4: When the current on-field character in the party hits opponents with Electro or Cryo attacks, the Anchor will launch a Coordinated Attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG at the opponents' location. This effect can trigger at most once every 1.5s.
description.6: Danica's Normal Attacks will be converted into Special Attacks using the anchor, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> that cannot be overridden by infusion. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
description.9: While the Anchor is present, Danica can accumulate Excitement by performing anchor Special Normal Attacks or by having the current on-field character in the party hit opponents with Cryo or Electro attacks. When Excitement reaches its maximum, depending on whether Danica is on-field, all Excitement can be consumed to unleash different special Elemental Skills and enter the corresponding Maid Form:
description.11: When Danica is off-field, switch to bring Danica on-field, automatically triggering "Entry Skill E2", and entering Defense Maid. Generates a Shield for the on-field character and refreshes the Anchor's Duration. During this time, "On-Field Skill E2" cannot be triggered.
description.13: When Danica is on-field, the Elemental Skill will be replaced by "On-Field Skill E2". After using it, Danica enters Battle Maid. While in this state, after using "On-Field Skill E2", the anchor Special Normal Attacks can skip certain Normal Attack combo hits. During this time, "Entry Skill E2" cannot be triggered.
description.15: Additionally, when the Anchor disappears, Danica will exit the Maid Form. While the Anchor is present, Battle Maid and Defense Maid cannot coexist — upon entering one Maid Form, the other cannot be entered.

description.0: Commanding the battlefield with the poise of the Tsaritsa's handmaiden, launches a 5-hit wide-range attack, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>.
3: The 1st and 5th hits additionally deal <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
For a period of time after use, if Danica is in Maid Mode, the current Maid Mode will be Enhanced, granting the corresponding Enhancement effect based on the current mode:
description.4: When Danica is in Defense Maid mode, increases ATK for all Characters in the party.
description.5: When Danica is in Battle Maid mode, immediately restores all Excited energy and increases the DMG dealt by Danica's "On-Field Skill E2".
description.7: When Maid Mode ends, the Enhancement effect will be removed.

description.0: Anchor decreases the Electro RES of nearby enemies by 15%.
description.2: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Further decreases the Electro RES of nearby enemies by 15% and their Cryo RES by 30%.

description.0: After casting 「Entry Skill E2」, Danica's own ATK increases by 20%.
description.1: After casting 「On-Field Skill E2」, Danica's own ATK SPD increases by 20%, and when the Special Anchor's Normal Attack hits an enemy, she additionally gains 25 Excited points. The above effects can stack up to 3 times.
description.2: The above effects last until exiting the current Defense Maid or Battle Maid state. Re-triggering will refresh the Duration.

description.0: When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct, and party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will be increased based on Danica's ATK: Every point of ATK she has increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.7%. The maximum increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
description.1: Additionally, when Danica is within a Polestar Field, she will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.

description.0: When your own Characters in the party are under the effect of Sheer Cold, Movement SPD increases by 10% and Stamina consumption decreases by 10%.
When Danica uses "Entry Skill E2" or "On-Field Skill E2", she restores 20 Elemental Energy for herself. This effect can trigger at most once every 14 seconds.
description.1: Additionally, the Defense Maid enhancement effect in Elemental Burst is increased by 80%, and the Battle Maid enhancement effect is increased by 120%.

description.0: While the Anchor is present, Danica grants 7 stacks of "Toast" to all nearby Characters. When all nearby Characters have consumed a total of 6 stacks of "Toast", the active Character on the field additionally gains 1 stack of "Toast".
description.1: "Toast": When a party Character triggers a Stellar-Conduct reaction, 1 stack of "Toast" will be consumed, increasing the DMG dealt. This increase is equivalent to 100% of Danica's ATK.
description.2: Additionally, when Danica triggers a Stellar-Conduct reaction while in Battle Maid Mode, all current stacks of "Toast" she possesses will be consumed. Each stack increases the DMG dealt, with each increase equivalent to 150% of Danica's ATK.
description.3: Resummoning the Anchor or refreshing its Duration will reset the stacks of "Toast".

description.0: Increases the Level of Elemental Burst by 3.

When the active on-field Character under the protection of Danica's Shield deals Stellar-Conduct DMG to opponents, regenerates 3 Elemental Energy for the other nearby party members. This effect can trigger at most once every 3.5s.
description.1: Additionally, when Danica enters the Battle Maid state, a Shield will also be generated. If Danica leaves the field while the Shield is active, it will be destroyed.

description.0: Increases the Level of Elemental Skill by 3.
While the test anchor is present, the Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by nearby characters in the party is increased by 20%.
description.1: Additionally, when Danica enters the Defense Maid state, every 1,000 ATK Danica has increases the Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by the on-field character by 10%, up to a maximum of 40%.
description.2: When entering the Battle Maid state, every 500 ATK Danica has increases her own on-field Skill E2's CRIT Rate by 2.5% and the CRIT DMG dealt by 25%. CRIT Rate can be increased by up to 10% and CRIT DMG by up to 100%.
description.3: The above effects last until exiting the current Maid state.
